system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
function: Upper chamber wall protective plasma liner
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for this chamber shield component where controlled Ra 3.2-6.3um roughness improves coating adhesion. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides ductility while maintaining corrosion resistance. This rationale is driven by upper chamber wall protective plasma liner and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for upper chamber wall application
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID — critical for upper chamber wall performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) suitable for Upper chamber wall protective plasma liner?
faq.a: Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address chamber shield operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for upper chamber wall requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. upper chamber wall components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for upper chamber wall application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Chamber Liner (Upper) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet upper chamber wall specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Chamber liner / Wall shield chamber shield components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
